snippet.title: Infinity Nikki Version 2.9 Trailer: Bloom Beneath Bright Skies
snippet.description:
Heartfelt Limited-Time Resonance: Resonate 10 Times, Get 10 Free | Infinity Nikki Version 2.9 Trailer: Bloom Beneath Bright Skies

The rustling leaves herald the start of the summer camp in Elderwood Forest!
Tuck your letters into tree hollows and let the campfire light the road ahead.
Take one bold step, then another, and carry laughter and courage toward wider, brighter skies!

Infinity Nikki Version 2.9 "Bloom Beneath Bright Skies" launches on August 27 (UTC-7)!

The Heartfelt Limited-Time Resonance event is coming soon! The new 5-star outfit will be available during the event. Each time you select [×10 Resonate] on the event page, an additional free 10-draw will trigger immediately. This bonus can be triggered 10 times, granting up to 100 free Resonances in total!

The limited-time exclusive quest "A Carefree Summer" opens, alongside fun new events, including "Into the Heartvoice Garden" and "Create! Let Imagination Roam!" More adventures and surprises await. See you there, stylists!

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.9 Bloom Beneath Bright Skies launches globally on August 27 (UTC-7)!
